result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one section header displays a raw localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') instead of a translated title, which is the main visual defect. Other elements (carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom) are expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The section header between 'Fastest near you' and the ramen restaurant card shows the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Provide the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the current locale (or add a fallback label) so the section header renders actual copy instead of the raw key.
